response.overview: Following a traumatic accident, a young woman returns to her secluded childhood home attempting to piece together forgotten fragments of her past. But the moment she steps inside, buried memories and unsettling visions begin to bleed into reality, turning the familiar halls into a living nightmare.  As the line between her mind and the house's dark history blurs, she is forced to confront a sinister presence tied to a hidden family tragedy. Trapped in a maze of hallucinations, grief, and psychological dread, she realizes too late that returning home was a fatal mistake.  BAD THINGS HAPPEN HERE delivers a chilling, deeply atmospheric descent into psychological horror, grief, and haunted family secrets. For fans of atmospheric mind-benders and cinematic hits like The Night House, Relic, The Dark and the Wicked, Heritage, or Oculus, this unsettling nightmare will keep you guessing until the final frame. Explore our full channel playlist for more full-length releases!
response.tagline: May God Have Mercy on Her Soul
response.title: Bad Things Happen Here
